title: AndroidFlux: Evaluating and Reward Modeling Failure Recovery Capabilities in Mobile Use Multimodal Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.34384v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mobile-use multimodal agents are typically evaluated by task success from a clean initial state, which does not isolate their ability to recover from intermediate errors. Because mobile environments change dynamically, a general mobile-use agent must complete tasks robustly even from unexpected states and in unseen environments. This requires knowing when and where an agent makes errors, and whether it can recover from errors and subsequent states. To evaluate this capability, we introduce AndroidFlux, a failure-recovery benchmark built on AndroidWorld. AndroidFlux restores recorded trajectories to controlled checkpoints before, at, and after the first recoverable error, so that different agents continue from the same device state and history. On these checkpoints, a complementary reward-modeling benchmark evaluates recovery-action preferences using downstream rollout outcomes. We further release an offline reinforcement learning (RL)

translated_title: AndroidFlux：评估移动使用多模态智能体的故障恢复能力并进行奖励建模
translated_abstract: 移动使用多模态智能体通常通过从干净的初始状态出发的任务成功率来评估，这种方法无法单独衡量它们从中间错误中恢复的能力。由于移动环境是动态变化的，一个通用的移动使用智能体必须能够在意外状态下以及未见过的环境中稳健地完成任务。这就需要了解智能体在何时何地犯错，以及它能否从错误及其后续状态中恢复。为了评估这一能力，我们提出了AndroidFlux，一个基于AndroidWorld构建的故障恢复基准。AndroidFlux将记录的轨迹恢复到第一个可恢复错误之前、之时和之后的受控检查点，使不同的智能体从相同的设备状态和历史记录继续执行。在这些检查点上，一个配套的奖励建模基准利用下游部署结果来评估恢复动作的偏好。我们进一步发布了离线强化学习（RL）……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了基于AndroidWorld的AndroidFlux故障恢复基准，通过在首个可恢复错误前、中、后设置受控检查点，使不同智能体从相同状态继续执行以评估其错误恢复能力，并配套奖励建模基准来评估恢复动作的偏好。
en_tdlr: Introduces AndroidFlux, a failure-recovery benchmark built on AndroidWorld that restores recorded trajectories to controlled checkpoints before, at, and after the first recoverable error, enabling evaluation of mobile multimodal agents' recovery capabilities along with a complementary reward-modeling benchmark for recovery-action preferences.
